ratio_to_yarkovsky_expectation_detected.note: |A2| over the thermal-recoil expectation at LOOM's measured median efficiency; an ordinary Yarkovsky population sits around 1, and a median far above it indicts the error model before it indicts the sky

controls.note: no object with an independently fitted A2 was in the sample; the estimator's sensitivity is UNEXERCISED, not passed

linkage_duplicates.note: orbital elements matched within (a, e, i) tolerances with disjoint observation epochs: consistent with one accelerating object entered under several designations, not with a family

tests.caveat: matched on H, arc length and observation count but NOT on inclination-dependent linking efficiency; a positive result is evidence about selection until that efficiency is measured
tests.name: inclination_isotropy

tests.interpretation: shallow slope / narrow spread is what a built-to-spec population looks like; steep is fragmentation
tests.name: size_distribution

budget_stop.note: stopped on the in-job clock so the checkpointed chunks survive; the remaining objects are UNMEASURED, not null
